_comment: OTA-232 — ingested verbatim from Canon_Event_Log.docx. The canonical timeline of Tartaria's collapse and aftermath. Surfaced into Qwen system prompts when the player's current location or scene tags match an event's keywords. Phase 2 will add MiniLM-backed 'ask the arbiter about X' lookup against this set.

events.title: The Lost Covenant of the Giants
events.outcome: Schism between the Giants and Nobles
events.summary: Tartarian Giants refused to share Etheric secrets with the noble families. The Giants retreated into the Urals, weakening Tartaria's leadership and seeding centuries of fragility.

events.title: The Etheric Conflux War
events.outcome: Partial collapse of the Etheric network
events.summary: A critical Etheric Conflux near the Caspian malfunctioned, sending devastating surges across the empire. Rebels backed by rogue nobles tried to harness it; the network broke and regions went dark.

events.title: The Fall of the Tartarian Capital (The Great Exodus)
events.location: Tartaria's Capital, now buried in the Great Tartary Plains
events.summary: After the Great Mud Flood, the royal bloodline and key engineers fled the capital. The survivors became the Mud Monarchs, hoarding Tartaria's knowledge and ruling from the shadows.

events.title: The Etheric Accords
events.summary: Surviving noble families signed an alliance to safeguard remaining Etheric technology. The accord laid the groundwork for the Mud Monarchs proper — power consolidated in the families that held working relics.

events.title: The Reclaimers' Uprising
events.summary: An underground skirmish broke out beneath Paris when Reclaimers uncovered Tartarian relics. The Forgotten Order and Mud Monarchs both moved to seize them; the Reclaimers formalized into a Guild and ran an underground black market.

events.title: The Northern Plague (The Etheric Rot)
events.summary: The Etheric Rot first appeared in Siberia — a disease tied to malfunctioning relics. The Mud Monarchs tried to quarantine; Revivalists exploited the chaos. Entire underground cities were abandoned and relics lost.

events.title: The Munich Coup (Ascension of the Conspiracy Architects)
events.summary: A coup led by what would become the Conspiracy Architects, originally part of the Mud Monarchs, seized Etheric relics and broke away. They blamed the Monarchs for reckless misuse and built a shadow apparatus to control global knowledge.

events.title: The Great Purge of Forgotten Knowledge
events.summary: The Architects, with world governments, systematically destroyed Tartarian archives beneath Istanbul. The purge erased most historical records of the empire, cementing Architect control over public knowledge.

events.title: The Vatican Relic Containment
events.summary: The Architects, working with the Catholic Church, contained Etheric relics found in the Vatican archives. The collaboration with religious institutions began here — keeping relics hidden beneath the Vatican for centuries.

events.title: The Shanghai Insurrection
events.outcome: Mud Monarchs' defeat, rise of the Revivalists
events.summary: During the Taiping Rebellion, Revivalists seized relics hidden beneath Shanghai. Rogue Reclaimers aided them in exposing Tartaria's history — a wave of public interest in Tartarian myths followed before the Architects quashed it.

events.title: The Siege of St. Petersburg
events.outcome: Forgotten Order gains critical Tartarian relics
events.summary: During WWI, the Forgotten Order ran a three-day covert siege beneath St. Petersburg and emerged with key Etheric devices. The win bolstered their long-term work and deepened the rivalry with the Mud Monarchs.

events.title: The Manhattan Relic Scandal
events.summary: Reclaimers found an Etheric relic beneath Manhattan during WWII. The Architects intervened, destroyed it before study, and cemented their dominance in suppressing Tartarian tech.

events.title: The Arizona Desert Conflict (Lost Capital Struggle)
events.outcome: Revivalist defeat, global awareness of Tartarian myths grows
events.summary: Revivalists found a lost Tartarian city in the Grand Canyon. The U.S. government, steered by the Architects, suppressed the operation in a week-long skirmish. The Revivalists lost, but rumors of Tartaria began to spread.

events.title: The Antarctic Expedition (Etheric Pulse Awakening)
events.summary: An Etheric pulse beneath the Antarctic ice triggered a covert expedition by the Forgotten Order. Mud Monarch agents sabotaged it; the Order still recovered ancient machines hinting at a global Etheric network.

events.title: The Tartarian Heir's Rebellion
events.summary: A group claiming descent from the original Tartarian rulers launched a rebellion in Warsaw, armed with newly-found Etheric devices. The Mud Monarchs crushed it in secret; rumors of the 'Tartarian Heir' still circulate.

events.title: The Berlin Betrayal
events.summary: A joint Reclaimer / Forgotten Order op beneath Berlin was sabotaged by the Mud Monarchs. Key Reclaimer operations across Europe were dismantled; the Monarchs consolidated their hold on the continent.

events.title: The Prague Summit Betrayal
events.summary: A secret summit meant to negotiate the controlled release of Tartarian tech was sabotaged by rogue Architects. Street clashes erupted in Prague; any chance of cooperation between the factions ended there.

events.title: The Singapore Relic Seizure
events.summary: The Reclaimers Guild seized a major cache of Tartarian relics in Singapore, outmaneuvering both the Monarchs and the Order. Renewed interest in relic-hunting triggered underground skirmishes across Southeast Asia.
